profile.headline: Software Engineer at Kahuna
profile.summary: Software developer with broad experience with a variety of technologies, specializing in back-end development and general optimization of algorithms/code, pursuing engineering roles that assist ambitious teams with their projects

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: C# · SQL · Back-End Web Development · .NET Framework · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description:
- Created simple batch jobs for maintaining data consistency with third-party applications, as well as migration from legacy databases for use within new infrastructure for scheduling appointments
- Wrote scripts for aiding with unit testing and code coverage, and a UI tool which helped QA validate and debug production issues more easily
- Led the team with best testing practices on ensuring code was tested thoroughly and consistently, this included one-on-one efforts with developers to meet minimum guidelines and walkthrough the various questions or issues
- Aided with DevOps efforts, including creation and validation of various Jenkins pipelines for use within production and lower environments
- Documented best strategies for common development practices such as new repositories and pipelines
- Refactored and streamlined code for various applications, reporting bugs and updating libraries and outdated logic

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description:
- Developed performant passthrough to multiple downstream APIs utilizing ASP.NET 6 with JWT OAuth or two-way SSL for secure connections
- Implemented several libraries for streamlining development, including a runtime/cached code generator using annotations to automatically handle data model validation consistently
- Worked with numerous DevOps and systems members to debug and correct issues with new Jenkins pipelines being built, as well as enhancing deployment scripts and Control-M jobs
- Coordinated efforts with downstream systems and upstream clients for performance issues, in-production errors, and overall project maintainability
- Enhanced unit tests to ensure full coverage of the code and features within
- Assisted other team members with getting up to speed on tooling or code practices, including documenting and organizing several workflows for better visibility and consistency with vulnerability/quality scans

positions.title: Senior Developer / Test Automation Lead
positions.description:
- Worked with team of Java developers to create and fully feature test REST API used by a bank to process various fees on transactions at over one hundred locations handling billions of dollars in total assets, complete with logging and retry functionality to have maximum throughput and reliability
- Utilized JUnit, Rest Assured, and Spring to test the API generated by team members and validate behaviors to match client expectations, both at an individual endpoint level, and for the overall workflow
- Diagnosed behaviors via Jenkins and Splunk to guarantee all environments behaved identically
Corrected SQL table configurations that led to unpredictable system-specific errors
- Reviewed core back-end code to both ensure code styles matched, as well as providing steps to catch and handle edge cases in the application
- Developed internal utilities for code generation using Swagger API documentation pages, matching the existing tools of the project rather than the preconfigured generation options provided
- Created and presented detailed overview of all code written before hand-off for the end of the contract, including providing outline of steps presented for reproduction by client if needed
- Assisted new team members to the project by reviewing client environments/tools as well as a walkthrough of code written by the team
- Worked closely with the development team and architect to provide suggestions on best practices

positions.title: Engineering Consultant
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Developed secure and reliable middleware with ASP.NET Core to assist a nation-wide advertising agency handling millions of customers with a core system used to negotiate time blocks and costs, communicating with existing infrastructure as needed
- Used FileHelpers library for conversion between legacy fixed length field format written on top of a message queue to a more modern RESTful API using JSON and backed by an SQL database
- Configured Swagger via NSwag to assist development process with automatic model generation used by Angular front-end written with TypeScript
- Created internal tooling to assist with repetitive code generation, such as the separate files used by command/query/model files and their respective tests as directed by the MediatR library’s workflow
- Optimized database seed script to allow for population of only the required tables, as dictated by individual test case needs and table dependencies, speeding up code fixes and overall Azure DevOps CI pipeline runtimes

positions.title: Research Technology Services (RTS) IT Student
positions.description:
- Maintained an accurate inventory of allocated hardware and centrally maintained software
- Created a few simple web interfaces used for navigating to commonly used links, including printers and their documentation pages and direct IP access
- Assisted team members with troubleshooting common technical issues and installation of software
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · HTML · High Level Of Accuracy · Scripting · JavaScript · Easily Adaptable · Programming · jQuery · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript Libraries · Analytical Skills · Customer Support
